candidates.title: Civitai prompt 145724044
candidates.prompt:
zidiusArt, @NJSW33T,
An illustration depicting the rampaging state of Evangelion Unit-01, the iconic bio-weapon from the Neon Genesis Evangelion series.
• Description of the berserk state: The rider is wide open with a sharp grin as if his restraints have been released, and intense white flashes of light burst from his eyes. The exposed red biological tissue around the neck gives it more of a giant monster or living creature appearance than that of a machine.
• Rugged style: Using splattered, ink-splattered textures and rough brushstrokes, it maximized the destructive energy and madness of the rampage, as well as the scars of brutal combat.
• Color contrast: The original purple of the Unit-01 and the fluorescent light green of the gloves are contrasted by red, blood-like marks, creating an even more bizarre and overwhelming atmosphere.
On the left side of the illustration, the following text and logo are neatly arranged as design elements.
• YOU ARE (NOT) ALONE.: This is the subtitle of Evangelion: New Theatrical Edition (Prologue) and the core message of the work.
• EVA UNIT-01 BERSERK / Rampage: Specifies the name of the vehicle and its current state of being out of control.
• NERV logo: The fig leaf mark of the special agency 'NERV,' which operates Evangelion, is placed at the bottom, giving it a more official poster feel.
